title: Build your security skills.
description: A clear starting point for curious learners.

learningPaths.title: Security foundations
learningPaths.description: Build a working vocabulary for confidentiality, integrity, availability, threat modeling, and risk.
learningPaths.topics: Security principles, Threat modeling, Risk and controls

learningPaths.title: Web application security
learningPaths.description: Study how web applications fail and how developers and testers can reduce those risks responsibly.
learningPaths.topics: HTTP and browsers, OWASP Top 10, Secure design

learningPaths.title: Systems and networks
learningPaths.description: Understand the operating systems, networks, and protocols that security work depends on.
learningPaths.topics: Linux basics, Networking, Identity and access

learningPaths.title: Security research practice
learningPaths.description: Learn a repeatable approach to scoped testing, evidence, documentation, and responsible disclosure.
